title: Agent Bots Marching
style: Big band funk with marching snare cadence, punchy brass stabs, syncopated bass, hype gang chants, and fast rap verses; verse rides tight snare-and-bass pockets, pre-hook strips to snapped claps and callouts, chorus hits with full brass blasts and crowd vocals, bridge opens to fanfare then slams back in. Close-mic lead rap with stacked doubles, shouted ad-libs, delay throws on hook words, brass fanfare risers and snare rolls into drops, bright punchy mix with huge low end and wide horn spread., clean, rap, big band, refined, noise, bright, light, world, happy, strong
